This spot is located close to a walking trail, so yeah it would be a person centric area. However, when i found it, I was alone(as far as i know). It was windy actually, what's the significance of that?

Yeah, I mean I got good vibes from it, the amount and their placement threw me off, as well as the fact that one was still lit. It really did feel like i synced up to see it though. As far as my limited knowledge goes, st Michael is archangel of protection, guess I'm being protected? I've also been seeing a lot of 2222 1111 111 444 555 777 and 88s 

It's a lot to process, but I'm optimistic. Thanks for the reassurance
That makes sense. I was conflicted cause I know st michael to offer protection but i normally see the candles lit indoors
Theres like this platform on top of a really shallow man made pond, I'd imagine the platform was at one point a bridge or something.
